phase: Preliminary manufacturer-documentation review; no hardware chosen

reference_driver.name: Dayton Audio RSS390HF-4
reference_driver.role: initial conditional leader, NOT binding choice

protection_and_limits: Research only: Xmax not Xdam; no final limit thresholds without measurement of real motor, BL(x), Cms(x), coil Re(T), heatsink and DSP timing
network: 230V AC; two subwoofer channels independent; 8 total channels (6 monitors and 2 subs)

dsp.name: miniDSP Flex Eight
dsp.price_scope: Full central DSP, shared by 8 channels. Tax/shipping excluded.
dsp.note: No analog inputs. Optional Dirac Live changes processing to 48 kHz and removes direct FIR/input-IIR user access. 2 Vrms only.

dsp.name: miniDSP Flex HTx
dsp.price_scope: Full central DSP, shared by 8 channels. Tax/shipping excluded.
dsp.note: TRS balanced gives 4 Vrms. RCA 2 Vrms. 8 channels analog in/out; independent channels not equivalent to 16 separate outputs. HDMI eARC LPCM; optional Dirac.

amplifier_variants.name: ICEpower 300AS1
amplifier_variants.protection_status: Refer to manufacturer datasheet, board-level protections not speaker Xmax monitor
amplifier_variants.notes: Price is a range for packaging types; not a per-channel all-in quote.

amplifier_variants.name: Hypex NC500MP
amplifier_variants.notes: Manufacturer data references default buffered gain 25.5 dB. NC500MP printed as document titled NC500MP despite file name NC500_OEM. 500 W is 1kHz resistive test, peak-time-limited.

amplifier_variants.name: Hypex NCx252MP one channel per sub
amplifier_variants.architecture: one integrated 2-channel module for two subwoofers
amplifier_variants.notes: Two 250W channels, independent audio/DSP but shared main SMPS on one PCB; continuous rating 50W per channel at 25degC must be respected. 4Ω BTL NOT recommended by manufacturer despite nominal 400W peak possible.

amplifier_variants.name: Hypex NC252MP one channel per sub
amplifier_variants.architecture: one integrated 2-channel module for two subwoofers
amplifier_variants.notes: Older NCORE, 2x250W per channel, distinguish continuous from time-limited 1kHz rating.

amplifier_variants.name: NC500 OEM + qualified external SMPS
amplifier_variants.architecture: external isolated certified SMPS plus amplifier PCB
amplifier_variants.notes: Concept only: no matched PSU rail/output-current/noise/thermal/EMI and no board revision verified; no numeric rating or cost asserted.

assumptions.clip_criterion: min(Pamp_4ohm, Uin²*10^(gain_db/10)/4) for resistive illustrative load only; 4 V is NOT available from Flex Eight RCA or HTx RCA
assumptions.cost: Whole-system price requires housing, IEC inlet, earthed safety enclosure, heatsink, wiring, trigger, certified supply, taxes and shipping. Unverified costs represented null.
